article.title: How to translate an in-person conversation on iPhone
article.method: Documentation-based instructions and Spek source review. Suggested non-private practice task, explicitly not an actual device demonstration or recorded translation. No translated output samples, native review, or accuracy comparison.

sourceChecks.supports: Conversation, Listen / Enter text, Play, View > Face to Face, More Options > Auto Translate and Play translations; downloaded-language conversation. Current guide, not a device test.
Language selection, text or speech, playback, and downloaded languages.
Settings > Apps > Translate > Languages and On-Device Translation. Article advises exact-task airplane-mode test.
Feature- and language-specific availability; no blanket all-languages claim.

Current iPhone Live translate: Conversation through speaker or headphones, Text only, Face to face, Speak pause/resume, Back exit, mode-dependent headphone requirements. Supersedes older September launch limitations.
Single-phrase Dictation; select languages and speak after tone; disabled control can indicate unavailable speech language.
Phone and FaceTime Live Translation have distinct controls and availability; separate from shared-phone conversation.
Compatible AirPods and Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone, software/language/region requirements. Article directs readers to current requirements without an exhaustive model or regional claim.
